abstract.para: Generate a &rear; recovery system. The recovery system includes a system-specific recovery installer and might include an internal file backup or reference an external file backup, depending on your backup solution.

important.title: Using debugscript mode might log secrets
important.para: This procedure uses debugscript mode to provide the most debugging information, including logging commands and arguments in the &rear; log file. However, be aware that secrets and sensitive information might also be logged. Make sure you remove or obscure this information before sharing the log file.

listitem.para: &rear; is installed on the system you want to back up.
If &rear; is configured to use an external storage medium like a USB device, make sure the device is available on the system you want to back up.
If your system boots with a UEFI boot loader, make sure the xorriso package is installed.

topic.para: Perform this procedure on the system you want to back up:

step.para: Create the recovery system, using the -D option to enable debugscript mode:

listitem.para: For basic backups with tar, use the rear mkbackup command to create both the file backup and the recovery system:
For third-party backup tools, use the rear mkrescue command to create only the recovery system:

step.para: Both commands perform the following steps:

listitem.para: Analyze the system and gather information, particularly about the boot loader and the disk layout, including partitioning, file systems, mount points, etc.
Create a bootable recovery system with the information gathered in the analysis.

step.para: The rear mkbackup command also calls the internal backup tool to back up system files and user files. The rear mkrescue command doesn't create a backup of the files.
If you used rear mkrescue, create a file backup using your third-party backup tool.

topic.para: If the command fails, find the issue by reviewing the command output and the log file at /var/log/rear/. You might need to install a package or adjust the &rear; configuration.
